Brow services

Brows that look
like your own.

Every brow treatment begins with consultation, mapping and colour matching. The best technique depends on skin, natural brow hair and your preferred finish.

Microblading

Fine hair-stroke brows that look like your own.

Ideal for
Normal to dry skin, thin or gappy brows and a natural, feathery effect.
What to expect
Mapping for symmetry, arch and length; pigment matching; numbing; then fine handheld strokes. Sessions usually take 2 to 3 hours.
Healing & longevity
Brows can look darker for 7 to 10 days, lightly flake in week one and have a soft phase around weeks 2 to 3. A perfecting session is planned at 6 to 8 weeks; results typically last 12 to 18 months.
When to wait
Very oily or textured skin can be better suited to ombre or combination brows. Treatment is not suitable during pregnancy, breastfeeding or chemotherapy.

Ombre powder brows

Soft, brushed-on definition that does not fade overnight.

Ideal for
Oily or combination skin, mature skin, or anyone who likes a defined, filled-in brow.
What to expect
Shape approval, pigment selection, numbing and softly layered shading. The front stays lighter while definition builds through the tail.
Healing & longevity
The colour looks stronger in the first week, then heals roughly 30 to 40 percent lighter. Results typically last 18 to 36 months, with a perfecting session at 6 to 8 weeks.

Combination brows

Strokes for realism. Shading for depth.

Ideal for
Most skin types, brows with gaps or thin tails, and those wanting definition with a softer front.
What to expect
Fine strokes are placed through the front, then soft powder shading adds fullness through the body and tail.
Healing & longevity
Combination brows typically last 18 to 24 months. A perfecting session refines the healed result.

Lips, cheeks & eyeliner

Fresh colour.
Soft definition.

We use careful mapping and undertone-led pigment selection to keep results refined, wearable and personal.

Lip blush

Your lips, softer, fuller-looking and always tinted.

Ideal for
Pale or uneven lips, lost definition and people tired of reapplying lip colour.
What to expect
Lip mapping, undertone-led shade testing, numbing and layered pigment. Lips can look swollen and intense for 1 to 3 days before softening.
Longevity
Typically 2 to 3 years, fading gradually. A perfecting session follows at 6 to 8 weeks.
Important
If you are prone to cold sores, tell us at booking. Preventive medication from your doctor may be needed.

Dark lip correction

Even out dark lips and reveal a healthier natural tone.

How it works
Colour-correcting pigment is used to neutralise grey, brown and purple tones before building a balanced lip colour.
Process
A skin assessment, colour analysis and often a test patch come first. Correction is gradual and commonly takes 2 to 3 sessions.
Be aware
Outcomes vary with skin depth and tone. Your consultation is where realistic expectations are discussed.

Cheek blush

A healthy flush that stays when makeup is off.

What it does
A faint, diffused wash of colour over the apples of the cheeks creates a subtle fresh look.
What to expect
Placement is mapped to the cheekbones and shade is kept skin-tone matched. Healing takes about a week and fades softly.

Eyeliner

Wake up with eyes already defined.

What it does
From a barely-there lash enhancement to classic liner or a soft wing, pigment is placed at or between the lash line.
Healing
Expect swelling for 24 to 48 hours and plan for no eye makeup for a week. Results generally last 2 to 5 years depending on style and skin.
When to wait
Active eye infections, severe dry eye or recent eye surgery need an individual suitability check.

Scalp micropigmentation

Density, designed
to look natural.

SMP places tiny pigment dots that replicate the look of hair follicles. It is a cosmetic solution; it does not regrow hair.

SMP for men

A sharper hairline and a fuller look, without surgery.

How it works
A hairline is designed with your age, face shape and natural growth in mind. Density is built over 2 to 3 sessions, usually a week or two apart.
Healing & longevity
Mild redness can last 1 to 3 days. Avoid washing the scalp, sweating and sun for the first 4 days. Results typically last 4 to 6 years before a refresh.

SMP for women

Visible scalp, softer. Thinning hair, fuller-looking.

What it does
For diffuse thinning, widening partlines, alopecia or traction hair loss, SMP reduces scalp contrast while working alongside existing hair.
Why it differs
Female SMP is lighter and more diffused. Pigment is matched to hair colour and texture so the result remains discreet up close.
Be aware
SMP does not regrow hair. A consultation confirms whether it suits your hair-loss pattern and goals.

Paramedical tattooing

Restoration with
sensitivity and care.

Paramedical PMU uses skin-matched pigment to restore the colour or appearance of stable scars, surgery, burns or pigment loss. Results are cosmetic, personal and vary.

Vitiligo camouflage

Reduce contrast. Restore confidence.

What it does
Skin-matched pigment can soften the appearance of stable vitiligo patches, beginning with a small test area.
Requirement
Vitiligo should be stable without new or spreading patches for at least 12 months, ideally confirmed by a dermatologist.

Stretch-mark camouflage

Soften the contrast of stretch marks.

What it does
Skin-matched pigment blends mature, pale marks with surrounding skin. It does not remove marks or change texture.
Best for
Fully mature white or silvery marks, generally 1 to 2 years old. Larger areas can need several sessions.

Scar coverage

Blend scars into your skin tone.

What it does
Colour-matched pigment may reduce the contrast of surgical, accident and some burn scars.
Requirement
Scars need to be fully healed and stable, commonly at least 12 months old. Raised, keloid or active scars need individual assessment and can need medical clearance.

Areola reconstruction

A gentle final step after breast surgery.

What it does
Areola and nipple tattooing can recreate a natural appearance using realistic shading and, where appropriate, 3D effects.
When to begin
After surgery and radiotherapy are complete, healing is finished and a surgeon has cleared treatment—often 3 to 6 months after surgery.
What to expect
Design and colour matching, numbing where sensation allows, then 1 to 2 sessions with a touch-up at 6 to 8 weeks.

Your PMU journey

Well prepared.
Well supported.

  1. 01

    Free consultation

    We listen, assess skin and discuss your goals and suitability.

  2. 02

    Design & mapping

    Your proposed shape is drawn and approved before any treatment begins.

  3. 03

    Patch test & treatment

    Patch testing is completed at least 24 to 48 hours before treatment where needed. Most sessions take 2 to 3 hours.

  4. 04

    Healing & refinement

    Written aftercare and a check-in support healing. A perfecting session at 6 to 8 weeks refines shape and colour.

Health screening: treatment may not be appropriate during pregnancy or breastfeeding, with active infection, rash, sunburn, chemotherapy, uncontrolled diabetes or a history of keloid scarring. Always disclose medications, blood thinners, allergies and recent Botox or filler.
